Provides concurrent HTTP fetching of remote feed files with support for multiple compression formats (bzip2, gzip, xz, zstd) and configurable proxy settings.

## Key Components

| Symbol | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MIMEType` | `int` enum | Typed constant set for supported content types: XML, Txt, JSON, Yml, HTML, Bzip2, Xz, Gzip, Zst |
| `FetchRequest` | struct | Input descriptor with `Target`, `URL`, `MIMEType`, and `LogSuppressed` fields |
| `FetchResult` | struct | Output container holding `Target`, `URL`, and decoded `Body` bytes |
| `FetchFeedFiles` | func | Concurrently fetches all requested URLs, collecting results or errors within a 10-minute timeout |
| `fetchFileWithUA` | func (internal) | Executes a single HTTP GET with a versioned `User-Agent`, optional proxy, and decompresses the response body based on `MIMEType` |
| `genWorkers` | func (internal) | Creates a worker pool of goroutines consuming from a task channel |

## Usage Example

```go
reqs := []util.FetchRequest{
    {
        Target:   "oval-rhel9",
        URL:      "https://example.com/oval/rhel9.xml.gz",
        MIMEType: util.MIMETypeGzip,
    },
    {
        Target:   "oval-ubuntu22",
        URL:      "https://example.com/oval/ubuntu22.xml.bz2",
        MIMEType: util.MIMETypeBzip2,
        LogSuppressed: true,
    },
}

results, err := util.FetchFeedFiles(reqs)
if err != nil {
    log.Fatalf("fetch failed: %v", err)
}

for _, r := range results {
    fmt.Printf("target=%s bytes=%d\n", r.Target, len(r.Body))
}
```

> **Proxy support:** Set the `http-proxy` key via Viper (e.g. `--http-proxy http://proxy:3128`) and all requests will be routed through it automatically.
